note: A sample library written for Quiz Forge's template: three short lessons on baking bread.

lessons.title: What bread is made of
objectives: Name the four ingredients of a basic loaf and what each one does.
Write a recipe in baker's percentages, measured by weight.

lessons.title: Kneading and gluten
objectives: Explain what kneading does to gluten.
Use the windowpane test, a rest or folds to judge and build strength.

lessons.title: Proofing and baking
objectives: Judge when a dough is proofed with the poke test.
Bake a loaf at the right heat, with steam, and know when it is done.
